question: On the frozen-neuron decomposition p-015e0710, does the size-matched share comparison (E187) read the same with three Gaussian draws of the random reference per side as with one?

recipe.reference: P3.9 run 1's random change, KL-matched form only (experiments/qwen_library_share/run.py random_state, its _kl read; the _norm read is not made): iid Gaussian matrices, per matrix seed null_seed(draw_seed, site) = 1000 draw_seed + site index, scaled to the state's per-matrix Frobenius norms on the 84 MLP matrices (attention set to zero, own_sites), split, times the one factor b that brings its KL on 16 rows to the state's (qwen_reading.scale_search, kl_match as the Lab), read on the arm's 128 rows of 256 tokens. Each read is size_matched/qwen.py floor(), called unchanged
recipe.draws: draw seeds 1 and 2 in this run; draw 0 is P3.9 run 1 (side reads) and E187 (floors)
recipe.side_reads: per pair, save (last, 5x) and side: the random change at that side's seed-0 state, unscaled: results/<pair>/d<d>/side/<arm>_s0_<save>_kl.json (in these records 'larger' names the arm read and 'c' is 1)
recipe.floor_reads: per pair and save: E187's floor, the random change at the larger side's seed-0 state times E187's c (size_matched/qwen.py cells): results/<pair>/d<d>/floor/<save>.json
recipe.pods: one pod per pair (copy_cipher, facts, gold), both draws: 12 reads plus stage 0

controls_stop_on_miss.W0: W0 as the fine-tune on 16 rows of each of the pair's row sets: K00 = K01 = K0, and under the all-zero split K10 = K11 = K0, within the Lab's id_tol (P3.9's control, unchanged)
controls_stop_on_miss.do_nothing: the do-nothing state through the split path on side A's seed-0 last state: share 1 within id_tol
controls_stop_on_miss.reproduce_d0: draw 0's KL-matched random change at side A's seed-0 last state reproduces P3.9's saved results/p-015e0710/run1/<A>_s0_last_kl.json regating within E187's share_tol (0.0002, experiments/size_matched/results/predictions.json qwen.thresholds.share_tol): this proves the per-draw seeding path and the call into floor()
controls_stop_on_miss.scored: every random read 'scored' (floor()'s check, as P3.9 run 1 and E187)
controls_stop_on_miss.K0: every read's K0 over its 128 rows equals P3.9's floor for its row set within k0_tol (QS.read, unchanged)

expected.W0: K00 = K01 = K0, K10 = K11 = K0 (P3.9: exact to id_tol)
expected.reproduce_d0: difference within 0.0002; same card class expected near 1e-6
expected.random_scale: b between about 30 and 500: P3.9 run 1 and E187's floors used 34.0 to 434.6 (the records' random.scale)
expected.random_share_lean: a lean, not a rule: each random share within the range P3.9 run 1 and E187's floors read, 0.81 to 1.06

description.seed_gaps: per pair and save, E187's matched gaps: side A's share minus side B's per seed 0-2, the larger side's states scaled by c (size_matched/results/qwen/<pair>/share/<save>/), the smaller side's P3.9 run 2 reads; recomputed by plot.py and asserted equal to E187's summary.json matched_gaps
description.random_gap_per_draw: side A's random share minus side B's at draw d, the larger side's from its floor read and the smaller side's from its side read, as E187 signed it; None unless both reads are 'scored'
description.per_draw_call: P3.9's and E187's rule, unchanged (qwen_library_share run.cell): band = |random gap of draw d| + spread; 'beyond band' if every |seed gap| > band with one sign, 'inside band' if |mean seed gap| <= band, 'mixed' else, 'unreadable' if under 3 seed gaps, any None, or the band None. Reported for each of draws 0, 1, 2
description.three_draw: per comparison: the range (min, max) of the scored random gaps over draws 0-2, and 'all above' if every seed gap > max, 'all below' if every seed gap < min (strict, values rounded to 9 places), else 'not all outside'; 'unreadable' if no draw is scored. An unscored draw is reported with value None and left out of the range, which is then taken over the remaining draws (n_draws says how many)
description.unmatched_last: per side, the last-save share of seeds 0-2 (P3.9 run 2) and the random share per draw at that side's seed-0 state (draw 0 P3.9 run 1, draws 1-2 this run's side reads), drawn as the paper's qwen_share frozen-neuron panel; no rule
